issues.spec_citation: DuckDB extension-loading semantics + fhir4ds extension.py docstring contract (bundled native C++ extension 'attempts to load ... falls back to vectorised Python UDFs')
issues.evidence: fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/extension.py _try_load_bundled_cpp_extension: on unsigned-signature LOAD failure it retries via `SET allow_unsigned_extensions = true` + LOAD. DuckDB rejects the SET on a running database (InvalidInputException: Cannot change allow_unsigned_extensions setting while database is running), so the retry branch can NEVER succeed; register_fhirpath(duckdb.connect()) silently downgrades every user (and the entire spec-compliance suite) to Python UDFs, with only an INFO-level log. Verified: direct LOAD with connect(config={'allow_unsigned_extensions': True}) works; plain connect + register_fhirpath returns False. Expected: either the documented retry works or the failure is surfaced accurately (no dead code implying a working fallback). Native==fallback output parity verified (IG examples, types and rows identical), so impact is silent performance downgrade + misleading code, not correctness.
issues.fix: extension.py: removed the impossible mid-session `SET allow_unsigned_extensions` retry (DuckDB rejects the SET while the database is running); replaced with an actionable WARNING naming duckdb.connect(config=...) / fhir4ds.connect(). Regression: test_unsigned_bundled_extension_falls_back_with_warning (fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_extension_parity.py). Validation: master gate 2832/2832 (ViewDef 144/144).
